description: Create or update a single label on a branch (upsert by key). Provide the key plus any of values (an object of languageCode -> string), status, or tags. Every language in values must be configured on the project, or the call is rejected with unknown_languages. Returns whether the label was created or updated and its resulting stored state. Use this to add a new translation key or change an existing one. Give every NEW key its `context` (a description of the UI element, plus charLimit/location when known) so translators and the AI get it right. Writes to the token's base branch unless `branch` names another allowed branch.

branch.description: Branch to operate on. Defaults to the token's base (bound) branch. May name any branch in the token's allowed set: its base branch, plus branches this token created (only when the token's scope is create-own; see list_branches). Naming any other branch fails with branch_not_allowed.

context.description: Translator context (developer role or higher). AI translation and the QA length check use it.

charLimit.description: Maximum length of every translation. Set it only when the UI clearly limits the length.

description.description: Which UI element this is and where it appears, e.g. "Submit button of the checkout payment form".

doNotTranslate.description: true when the text must stay the same in every language (a product name, brand or code): AI translation then copies the source text instead of translating it. false clears it.

location.description: Where the string is used, as "path:line".

status.description: Optional status string to set on the label.

tags.description: Optional tags to set on the label (developer role or higher).

values.description: Per-language values as { languageCode: string }; only configured languages are allowed.

name: upsert_label
title: Create or Update Label
